contact.basis: Original native-context extent midpoint selected before independent full field or any model/floor/mainsection geometry. GSI ground elevations are factual source data, not measured archaeological construction phases or a surveyed host-terrain tie.

numericNoDataFallback.policy: Original DEM1A first; original DEM5A, DEM5B, DEM5C, DEM10B in official order only where finer interpolation includes no-data, as official GSI hierarchy. No synthetic fill.

verticalDatum: Original GSI published elevation datum. No surveyed vertical tie to global Terrarium/host terrain or medieval construction level is claimed.

sources.role: Original numeric no-data fallback only; not terrain fitting

attribution: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, original numerical DEM1A elevation tiles
method: Original signed24bit-centimeter numeric DEM1A values bilinearly sampled at source pixel centres in original fixed native-context frame. Source values are heights, not appearance colors. Complete512m independent field chosen before floors/mainsections/geometry, without flattening, masks, ground openings, relocation or fitting. Where original DEM1A has numeric no-data, query original DEM5A/5B/5C/10B in the GSI published resolution hierarchy; no synthetic values or flat fill.
limitations: Nominal~1m source pixels and2m independent grid spacing are not archaeological boundary or date evidence.
Original digital terrain may contain measurement/interpolation effects, small structures and later landscape changes; exact historical grade is unverified.
The small original lower native ruins polygon does not describe the whole castle. Field contains natural ground and later context; no whole natural hill or shrine is a castle model.
